content.value_statement: Medical teams need help choosing safe workflows across many biomedical tasks. This skill maps requests to OpenClaw capabilities and Codex execution guidance.
actual_capabilities: Routes named medical skills or task descriptions to entries in the OpenClaw capability index.
Guides clinical, literature, drug, genomics, trials, imaging, device, and data analysis workflows.
Maps OpenClaw and NanoClaw assumptions to Codex tools, local files, web verification, Python, R, and connectors.
Defines safety boundaries for patient-facing summaries, emergencies, and high-risk medical outputs.
Requires auditable methods, source dates, evidence tables, provenance, and reproducible scripts when appropriate.
limitations: Does not provide definitive diagnosis, prescriptions, treatment orders, or regulatory clearance.
Depends on available files, installed tools, connectors, and current primary sources for execution.
OpenClaw-specific APIs or MCP services may be unavailable in a Codex session.
Requires qualified clinical, genetics, regulatory, or institutional review for high-stakes outputs.

use_cases.title: Clinical Evidence Drafting
use_cases.description: Summarize records or literature into clinician-reviewable drafts with source provenance and safety caveats.

use_cases.title: Bioinformatics Workflow Planning
use_cases.description: Select relevant genomics, omics, or pipeline capabilities and produce reproducible analysis plans.

use_cases.title: Regulatory And Device Research
use_cases.description: Create checklists and draft summaries for medical device, software, quality, and regulatory workflows.

prompt_templates.title: Find A Capability
prompt_templates.prompt: Find the relevant OpenClaw capability for this task: [task]. Explain why it fits and list any safety limits.

prompt_templates.title: Draft A Clinical Summary
prompt_templates.prompt: Summarize this medical source for clinician review. Separate evidence, assumptions, red flags, and recommended professional follow-up.

prompt_templates.title: Plan An Omics Analysis
prompt_templates.prompt: Map this genomics or omics question to a reproducible workflow. Include inputs, quality checks, tools, parameters, and expected outputs.

prompt_templates.title: Design A Regulated Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan a medical device AI workflow for this use case. Include risk class, evidence needs, standards, validation, and review roles.

output_examples.input: Find the best capability for a drug interaction review.
output_examples.output: The skill identifies drug safety and interaction capabilities, asks for missing medication details, and returns a clinician-reviewable evidence outline.

output_examples.input: Plan analysis for a single-cell RNA sequencing study.
output_examples.output: The response names relevant omics capabilities, lists required metadata, proposes quality checks, and defines reproducible analysis outputs.

output_examples.input: Create a regulatory checklist for medical AI software.
output_examples.output: The skill frames jurisdiction, intended use, risk controls, validation evidence, documentation needs, and expert review checkpoints.

best_practices: De-identify protected health information before sharing examples or data.
Use primary sources for current labels, guidelines, trials, and regulatory facts.
State assumptions, source dates, uncertainty, and review requirements in every high-risk output.
anti_patterns: Do not ask the skill for definitive diagnosis, treatment orders, or emergency triage replacement.
Do not rely on old database facts without checking current primary sources.
Do not run analyses on undocumented or poorly described biomedical data.

faq.question: What does this skill do?
faq.answer: It routes biomedical and medical tasks to relevant OpenClaw capabilities and Codex execution guidance.

faq.question: Can it diagnose patients?
faq.answer: No. It supports education, research, drafting, and decision support that requires qualified professional review.

faq.question: Which AI tools does it support?
faq.answer: It supports Claude, Codex, and Claude Code workflows through the marketplace metadata.

faq.question: Does it require OpenClaw to run?
faq.answer: No. The Codex adaptation uses the OpenClaw capability index as reference material.

faq.question: Can it handle patient data?
faq.answer: It can help with provided data, but users should minimize and de-identify protected health information.

faq.question: Why are safety caveats included?
faq.answer: Medical, regulatory, and genomic outputs can affect high-stakes decisions and require expert review.
